figures.caption: Figure 1: Mean population firing rates under sustained homogeneous input. The no-memory control has a firing threshold fixed at zero, while the reinforced systems use α = 0.5 and the indicated values of p. The shaded regions represent empirical interquartile ranges over 50 realizations.
Figure 2: Mean effective firing threshold θ(t) under sustained homogeneous input for the reinforced systems. Each curve is averaged over 50 realizations.
Figure 3: Single-exponential and power-law fits to the mean firing-rate trajectory for p = 0.75, using data from t = 10 onward.
Figure 4: Median total number of firings as a function of the threshold coefficient α and the leakage rate γ, with p = 0.7 and N = 100.
Figure 5: Mean population firing rates for the undriven finite network and the RMF particle approximation. The shaded regions represent empirical interquartile ranges over 20 realizations.
